rag_rationale: Programme is 15 points behind plan and the product catalogue slip is now delaying three other initiatives.
headline: Product catalogue migration slips six weeks to December, delaying three AI initiatives; contractor roll-off threatens more.

risks.title: Contract data engineers roll off 31 Oct
risks.description: Half the contract engineering capacity leaves when the SOW ends unless the extension is approved, pushing the catalogue to January and the customer domain to Q2 2027.
risks.mitigation: Escalate SOW extension to CFO; cross-train two internal engineers (partial cover).
risks.evidence: two of our four contract data engineers roll off on 31 October when the current statement of work ends

risks.title: Product data quality debt unowned
risks.description: Legacy PIM data needs about 3 FTE from Product Management for six weeks; no business owners committed yet.
risks.mitigation: Proposed data quality sprint awaiting sponsor decision.
risks.evidence: The business data owners for product have not committed people to the cleanup.

risks.title: Catalogue delay on critical path
risks.description: The product catalogue domain feeds the copilot knowledge index and forecasting SKU mapping; its slip directly delays both.
risks.mitigation: Downstream teams informed of early-December forecast.
risks.evidence: The product catalogue domain is on the critical path for at least two other initiatives

risks.title: Legacy warehouse licence renewal
risks.description: If migrations are not complete by 1 March 2027 the old warehouse licence must be renewed for another year.
risks.evidence: the old warehouse licence renews 1 March 2027 (approx €420k)

risks.title: Named-user access grants
risks.description: Without role-based groups from the Identity programme, access is managed per user, adding overhead and audit findings.
risks.mitigation: Access packages from IT-07 due 30 Oct.
risks.evidence: creating admin overhead and audit findings

dependencies.what: Role-based access groups to replace named-user grants

asks: CFO decision on contractor SOW extension by 24 Oct
Product Management to release 3 FTE for a six-week data quality sprint
